name: Taxes
description: VAT and sales tax. A tax is either included in the price (the CIS way — the price on the shelf is final and the tax is extracted from it for the invoice) or added on top at checkout (the US way); that is one checkbox per tax, so a shop can have both. Products carry their own taxes when they differ from the default.

settings.label: Show storefront prices with tax
settings.help: Only affects taxes that are ADDED to the price: the catalogue then shows what the customer will pay. Taxes already included in the price are shown as they are stored, whatever this is set to.

options.line: Per line — round the tax of the whole line
options.unit: Per unit — round the tax of one item, then multiply

settings.label: Where to round
settings.help: Both are legal in different places and differ by a cent on odd quantities. Per line is the safer default: the total matches the sum shown on the invoice.
